Theme

Latin word

custōdia

custōdia, custōdiae f.

noun, first declension

custody; custody; a place of confinement; a prisoner under guard; in the plural, the prisoners

In this lexicon

  • arrest

    also used · classical · Traupman 300

  • prison

    also used · classical · Caes. BC 3.104: in custōdiā necātur (Lewis & Short); Traupman 194

  • prisoner

    the recommended word · classical · Sen. Ep. 5.7; Plin. Ep. 10.19.1; Suet. Tib. 61 (Lewis & Short)
